questions.question: Describe how you would design a maintainable Selenium and TestNG automation framework for a web application, including page-object structure, test-data management, reporting, and parallel execution.

Your recent work has focused on Ruby on Rails and React applications. How would you apply your experience with RSpec, Capybara, and TDD when transitioning to a Core Java, Selenium, TestNG, and BDD-based test automation stack?
Walk through a feature you tested or delivered in an Agile environment. How did you derive test scenarios, collaborate with developers, document defects, and validate the fix?
How would you automate testing for a RESTful HTTP service, including positive, negative, authentication, validation, and error-handling scenarios?
Give an example of a SQL query you would write to validate that data displayed in a web application matches the underlying database after an automated workflow completes.

You have worked with Azure DevOps, Bamboo, and automated deployment processes. How would you integrate an automated Selenium/TestNG regression suite into a CI/CD pipeline, and what quality gates would you configure?
Describe your approach to investigating a flaky UI automation test. What evidence would you collect, and how would you distinguish an automation synchronization issue from a genuine product defect?

In your Bond Management application work, you used scheduled jobs, payment processing, REST services, and caching. What end-to-end test cases would you prioritize for a scheduled auto-renewal and payment workflow?
How have you used Unix/Linux shell scripting, logs, or command-line tools to troubleshoot an application or deployment issue, and how would those skills support test execution in a CI environment?

Describe a time you identified a performance or scalability issue using tools such as New Relic APM or through system testing. How did you isolate the issue and work with the development team on a solution?
